Only Alpha0 changes 3→16; all SF=255, DC=8, Blend=8, Dynamic=1. Digital requests before budgeting.
Colours identify bins, not brightness. Only bins present in these inputs are listed.

② Which Alpha each cell uses
α4: 32 edge cells; α7: 96 inner cells
Only α0 changes; these bright cells use α4/7.
Mostly black plus a small white patch in every cell: all α0.
Zoom into one local cell: how black and white form Mean
Grey bar = before; coloured bar = after. All bars use the same linear raw scale: 0–65280.
Logical cells are not physical LED shapes. Request changes are not luminance ratios; alignment and geometry matter.
